description: Remove the sharing/preview modal flow from all 4 card generator pages and replace the dlCard() function to directly display the animated card on-page with only 2 buttons: HD Photo Save and Video Download. Also rewrite js/video-capture.js to capture the actual on-screen card element (not a separate canvas animation) for 5 seconds.
steps: Step 1: Rewrite js/video-capture.js - Replace the current canvas-animation-based approach with a new function that: (a) Takes a DOM element reference (the card container), (b) Uses html2canvas to render the card to an offscreen canvas at each frame, OR uses the element's own rendering with a canvas overlay approach. Since the cards use CSS animations which html2canvas cannot capture, the best approach is: create a canvas, use canvas.captureStream(30) + MediaRecorder, and for each frame render the card element onto the canvas using a combination of drawing a static background + animated particles via JS. ACTUALLY - the simplest reliable approach: Use the existing card element on screen with a wrapper approach. The function should: (1) Check MediaRecorder support, (2) Wrap the card element's parent in a container, (3) Use the 'html2canvas' approach to capture a single high-res frame of the card as a base image, (4) Then use a canvas animation similar to current approach but with the actual card image as background + animated particles/sparkles overlay for 5 seconds, (5) Record that canvas via captureStream + MediaRecorder, (6) Download as WebM. Export a simple function: recordCardVideo(cardElement, options) that returns a Promise<Blob>. Duration should be 5000ms. Remove the old generateThumbnail export since it was only used by card-share.js.

Step 2: Remove the <script type='module'> import block from birthday.html that imports card-share.js and firebase-config.js. Remove the window._showCardPreview, window._shareCard, window._showShareUI assignments.

Step 3: Rewrite birthday.html dlCard() function - Instead of building an HTML string and calling _showCardPreview or downloading HTML blob, it should: (a) Hide the form column, (b) Create/show a full-screen card display area with the generated card rendered directly in the DOM (use the same HTML structure but insert it into the page), (c) Below the card show exactly 2 buttons: '📸 HD Photo Save Karo' (triggers the Canvas2D HD export that was previously inside the generated HTML) and '🎬 Video Download Karo' (triggers the new video capture function from js/video-capture.js). Also update the download section text to say 'Animation + HD photo + Video milenge' instead of mentioning HTML file.

Step 4: Do the same for birthday-fullphoto.html - Remove module imports, rewrite dlCard() to display card on-page with 2 buttons instead of showCardPreview/HTML download. The card already has the sHD() Canvas2D export logic built into its generated HTML - repurpose that for the HD button.
Step 5: Do the same for birthday-fullphoto-5.html - Remove module imports, rewrite dlCard() to display card on-page with 2 buttons.
Step 6: Do the same for congrats.html - Remove module imports, rewrite dlCard() to display card on-page with 2 buttons. Note: congrats uses handleHDSave() naming.

Step 7: Update the CTA section text in all 4 files - change the

helper text to reflect the new flow (remove mentions of HTML file download). Change birthday.html from '🎉 Animation wali HTML file milegi / 📸 Card ke andar HD Photo Save button bhi hoga' to '📸 HD Photo + 🎬 5 Second Video milegi'. Similar updates for other files.

Step 8: Add a <script type='module'> block in each of the 4 files that imports only the recordCardVideo function from js/video-capture.js (not card-share.js or firebase-config.js) and assigns it to window for use by the video download button.
acceptance_criteria: No reference to showCardPreview, shareCard, showShareUI, or firebase-config.js in any of the 4 card generator HTML files
No HTML blob download (no Blob with type text/html, no .html download filename) in any card generator page
Each card generator page has a dlCard() function that renders the card directly on the page (not in a modal or iframe)
Each rendered card view has exactly 2 action buttons: HD Photo Save and Video Download
The HD Photo Save button uses Canvas 2D API to export a PNG (using the existing pattern with html2canvas or manual canvas drawing)
The Video Download button calls the new recordCardVideo function from js/video-capture.js
js/video-capture.js exports a recordCardVideo function that records 5 seconds of animated canvas and downloads as WebM
Firebase config files (firebase.json, .firebaserc, functions/, etc.) remain untouched in the repo
js/firebase-config.js and js/card-share.js files remain in the repo (just not imported by card pages)
No JavaScript syntax errors in any modified file
verification: Run: grep -l 'showCardPreview\|shareCard\|showShareUI\|firebase-config' birthday.html birthday-fullphoto.html birthday-fullphoto-5.html congrats.html - should return NO results
Run: grep -l 'text/html.*Blob\|download.*\.html' birthday.html birthday-fullphoto.html birthday-fullphoto-5.html congrats.html - should return NO results
Run: grep -c 'recordCardVideo' js/video-capture.js - should return at least 1
Run: grep -c 'HD Photo Save\|Video Download' birthday.html birthday-fullphoto.html birthday-fullphoto-5.html congrats.html - each file should have both strings
Verify js/video-capture.js has valid JS syntax: node --check js/video-capture.js
Verify firebase.json, .firebaserc, functions/index.js still exist unchanged
findings: All 4 HTML files updated successfully. video-capture.js rewritten with single recordCardVideo export. HD save uses Canvas 2D manual drawing. The congrats.html file needed special handling due to its larger generated HTML template that was cut. No build or test runner in this project - validation was structural (JS syntax check, grep for removed references).
